tr.conditions: San Marino İtalya toprakları ile çevrilidir; bağımsız sınır kontrolü yoktur. İtalya ve Schengen vize kuralları geçerlidir. Türk umuma mahsus pasaport hamilleri Schengen vizesine tabidir (Yeşil pasaporta vizesiz).

us.conditions: US citizens can enter San Marino visa-free under Schengen area entry rules through Italy.

source.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of San Marino

de.conditions: German and EU citizens enter San Marino freely using an EU national ID card or passport via Italy.

source.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of San Marino

gb.conditions: British passport holders can visit San Marino visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day window via Italy.

ru.conditions: Гражданам РФ требуется действующая шенгенская виза для въезда в Сан-Марино через территорию Италии.

dos.title: Get an official souvenir passport stamp
dos.description: Visit the Tourist Information Office in Piazza Garibaldi to receive the official San Marino souvenir visa stamp for €5.

dos.title: Walk the Passo delle Streghe (Witches' Path)
dos.description: Walk the dramatic stone ridge connecting the Guaita and Cesta fortress towers with 360° views stretching to the Adriatic Sea.

dos.title: Take the scenic Funivia cable car
dos.description: Park in Borgo Maggiore below and ride the cable car up to Mount Titano to enjoy stunning panoramic views and avoid hilltop parking.

donts.title: Don't refer to San Marino as part of Italy
donts.description: San Marino is a proud independent republic founded in 301 AD; acknowledging its distinct sovereignty is appreciated.

donts.title: Don't drive into the medieval pedestrian zone
donts.description: The hilltop historical center (ZTL) is strictly pedestrian-only; camera-controlled fines apply to unauthorized cars.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 5-10% is customary in sit-down restaurants in San Marino for attentive service.
